experiments.why: A fenced, pretty-printed valid response with newlines between tokens must still give topic_refs [0,1] through the new lenient parser.
Raw unescaped newlines inside title and intro: the old parse rejects them, and the new salvage must still give "a b" and "c d".
A response cut off inside a topic_idx number, where truncation salvage may turn a partial digit into a citation of topic 1.
A fenced response truncated mid-title of the second chapter, which the old parse rejects and the new salvage may accept with fewer chapters.
Plain non-JSON text must still give ok:false, while the failure reason text changes with the lenient parser.
A literal JSON null: the old code reads .chapters of null and throws, the new code treats it as unparseable and returns ok:false.

source.quote: resolves topic_idx, drops out-of-range + duplicate, strips code fence

obligations.statement: parseSkeletonResponse strips a ```json code fence and turns each chapter's topic_idx into topic_refs, dropping out-of-range and repeated indices (topic_idx [0,1,9,1] with 3 topics gives topic_refs [0,1]).

source.quote: drops a chapter that cites no real topic (no fabrication)

obligations.statement: parseSkeletonResponse drops a chapter whose topic_idx cites no valid topic and keeps the chapters that do (with 2 topics, a chapter citing only 99 is dropped and the one citing 0 remains).

source.quote: collapses stray newlines in title/intro (JSON-parse guard)

obligations.statement: parseSkeletonResponse collapses a newline in a chapter's title or intro, with its surrounding whitespace, into a single space (a title of a, newline, b gives "a b"; an intro of c, newline, space, d gives "c d").

source.quote: does not place one topic in two chapters (dedup across chapters)

obligations.statement: parseSkeletonResponse never places one topic in two chapters: an index already used by an earlier chapter is dropped from later ones (chapters citing [0,1] and [1,2] give topic_refs [0,1] and [2]).

source.quote: fails on non-array / invalid JSON / no-valid-refs

obligations.statement: parseSkeletonResponse returns ok:false when chapters is not an array, when the text is not JSON at all (such as "not json"), or when no chapter cites a valid topic index.

source.quote: returns skeleton + computes unplaced topics (transparency)

obligations.statement: synthesizeBookSkeleton resolves ok:true with the model's chapters and lists in unplaced the indices of topics no chapter placed (one chapter citing [0,2] of 3 topics gives unplaced [1]).

source.quote: retries then hard-fails on provider error

obligations.statement: When every model call rejects, synthesizeBookSkeleton retries and then resolves with ok:false instead of rejecting.

source.quote: expect(r).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: 'no_topics' });

obligations.statement: synthesizeBookSkeleton with an empty topic list resolves to { ok: false, reason: 'no_topics' } without calling the model.

source.quote: Honest fail → ok:false (caller keeps the prior per-video sections).

obligations.statement: When synthesizeCellTopics cannot produce topics, it resolves with ok:false rather than throwing or rejecting.

source.quote: provenance (atom_refs resolved from LLM indices); never fabricates a vid/ts.

obligations.statement: Every topic synthesizeCellTopics returns carries atom_refs resolved from the model's indices against the input atoms, and it never invents a video id or timestamp.

source.quote: 429 and 5xx are safe to retry (no generation completed).

obligations.statement: isRetryableStatus returns true for status 429 and for every 5xx status.

source.quote: Honour Retry-After (delta-seconds or HTTP-date) when present; else exponential backoff.

obligations.statement: When a Retry-After value (delta-seconds or HTTP-date) is given, retryDelayMs bases the delay on it instead of on the exponential backoff for the attempt.

source.quote: maps idx→section index-aligned, strips fence, extracts keyPoint + keyPoints back-compat

obligations.statement: parseChapterBodyResponse strips a ```json fence and places each section at its idx, keeping its narrative and keyPoint as given.

source.quote: preserves markdown newlines in narrative (NOT collapsed — markdown depends on them)

obligations.statement: parseChapterBodyResponse keeps newlines inside a section's narrative instead of collapsing them (two paragraphs separated by a blank line come back with both newlines).

source.quote: leaves an empty-narrative slot for an omitted topic (caller keeps original summary)

obligations.statement: parseChapterBodyResponse still returns ok:true when the response omits a topic, and that topic's slot has narrative '' and keyPoints [].

source.quote: ignores out-of-range idx

obligations.statement: parseChapterBodyResponse ignores a section whose idx is out of range and still maps the valid sections.

source.quote: fails on invalid JSON / non-array / none mapped

obligations.statement: parseChapterBodyResponse returns ok:false for text that is not JSON, for a sections field that is not an array, and when no section maps to a valid topic index.

source.quote: retries then fails on provider error (caller keeps summaries)

obligations.statement: When every model call rejects, weaveChapterBody retries and then resolves with ok:false instead of rejecting.

source.quote: expect(r).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: 'no_topics' });

obligations.statement: weaveChapterBody with an empty topic list resolves to { ok: false, reason: 'no_topics' } without calling the model.

source.quote: returns ONLY hasSource===true sentences (fact claims)

obligations.statement: selectCheckWorthy returns exactly the sentences with hasSource === true and leaves out every sentence with hasSource === false.

source.quote: parses well-formed JSON array into CheckResult[]

obligations.statement: parseFactcheckResponse turns a well-formed JSON array of results into ok:true with one CheckResult per item, keeping each verdict.

source.quote: Returns ok:false on JSON parse failure or empty result.

obligations.statement: parseFactcheckResponse returns ok:false when the response is not valid JSON or yields no results.

source.quote: Honest fail → ok:false. Logs verdict distribution for observability.

obligations.statement: When factchecking cannot complete, factcheckChapterBody resolves with ok:false rather than throwing or rejecting.
